# ccpace

> Pace your Claude quota. One Python file (`ccpace.py`, PEP 723, `uvx ccpace`):
> real 5h/7d/per-model utilization from Anthropic's usage endpoint for one or
> many accounts, a countable 5h-window budget, a window ledger (where the
> week went), weekday forecasts learned from your own history, watch mode
> with push notifications (ntfy, bark, custom hook). Shares its fetch pool and
> sample log with claude-code-statusline; never estimates from transcripts.

Key facts for agents:
- The whole tool is `ccpace.py`; `pyproject.toml` wraps it for PyPI. Deps: httpx.
- Reads Claude Code credentials from `~/.claude/.credentials*.json` (or `-f`),
  refreshes expired tokens via the official OAuth flow (the one write it does).
- State: `~/.claude/statusline/[accounts/<tag>/]` — usage.cache / profile.cache /
  usage.jsonl / week.cache, the same files claude-code-statusline writes; the
  layout and record shape are in docs/data.md (the contract) and
  docs/statusline-interop.md.
- Request discipline: pool first (a usage.cache < 60 s is the fetch), idle gate
  in watch mode (no Claude Code activity + no reset -> no request), failures
  show the last cache badged — never a lockout.
- The grammar (rows, ledger glyphs, provenance badges, words) is DESIGN.md;
  it is the same grammar as claude-code-statusline/DESIGN.md.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/thevibeworks/ccpace/blob/main/README.md): install, what it shows, notifications, caveats

- [Data contract](https://github.com/thevibeworks/ccpace/blob/main/docs/data.md): store layout, record shape, fetch pool, forecast inputs
- [Statusline interop](https://github.com/thevibeworks/ccpace/blob/main/docs/statusline-interop.md): how the two tools share one store
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/thevibeworks/ccpace/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): per-release rationale
